items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: my first drum hero was Baby Dodds

ctx.x: Yeah. Because if there’s a lot like oral history and so forth.

Oh yeah. That’s important too, that that’s the other thing. I don’t make any value judgments because invariably they’re wrong in some form or another. But what I will say is that the hardest thing to do with most students is to get them to listen to the past. Because there’s such great peer pressure to be hip and current. And I talk to my students, I say, “When I was a kid and my father would bring home at first 78s but later on 33-1/3 LPs” and I said, “I would play those damn things until I, without knowing, I…
And that is increasingly, in my experience — where now it’s, “Yes, I’ve seen it on YouTube.” And considering most people’s attention span maybe they watched Baby Dodds for 30 seconds.
